newsitem.title: USA: KeyCorp forms new corporate finance unit.
newsitem.headline: KeyCorp forms new corporate finance unit.

text.p: KeyCorp said it has formed a new subsidiary, Key Corporate Capital Inc, to take its corporate and specialty finance businesses nationwide.

KeyCorp said the new unit is part of Key's corporate bank. Key said its corporate bank is planning to open 12 new offices outside Key's existing territory. The locations range from Boston to New York to San Francisco, the company said.
James Bingay, KeyCorp group executive vice president, has been named chairman of the new subsidiary, which will be headquartered in Cleveland.
